name: Quantum Metal Exchange Inc.
summary: Quantum Metal Exchange Inc. (QMEI) offers a mobile application named VuMee, accessible to users on both iOS and Android devices. This platform allows individuals to film, label, upload, and distribute videos featuring celebrities and various brands. Through VuMee, fans can receive email and SMS notifications from their favorite public figures when new content is released. The application also facilitates viewing, tweeting, posting, and sharing these videos with their social circles. A core aspect of VuMee is empowering celebrities, brands, and their admirers to maintain complete authority over their own video content through dedicated channels. The company, which began operations in 2011, was previously known as Vumee, LLC before adopting the name Quantum Metal Exchange Inc. in June 2021. Its headquarters are located in Las Vegas, Nevada.
